name: Income inequality (Gini index)
source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B19083, Monterey County row; underlying estimate is U.S. Census Bureau ACS
notes: ACS table B19083, universe Households, B19083_001 estimate 0.4567; reported margin of error is 0.0168. The response identifies Monterey County as GEOID 05000US06053 and release ACS 2024 1-year. County/DataShare higher-tier search did not produce an accessible current value; Census Bureau API query attempts returned HTTP 503 and direct data.census.gov table URLs were inaccessible in the research browser. Census Reporter redisplays ACS data and is therefore classified tier 3 for this finding, with primary-source access limitation disclosed.
